features.title: Local asdd ui server (bind + read-only)
features.user_visible_behavior: asdd ui [--port <n>] serves on 127.0.0.1 with Node builtins only; non-GET methods return 405 and nothing writes to the repo.
features.evidence: Final ship verify: node --test cli/src/harness/ui-server.test.mjs → 5/5; asdd ui registered; HARNESS_DRIFT_BASE=1b1fbae.
